info.title: API-DocTest-List Realestate Listings Favorites-v2-spec
info.description: The Favorite Real Estate Listings API allows users to access and view a curated list of their favorite real estate listings. This endpoint is designed for users who want to easily track options in their home search process. Consumers of this API typically include real estate platforms and mobile applications that enhance user experiences by providing quick access to saved properties. By fetching this favorite listings data, applications can improve engagement and streamline the property selection process for potential buyers.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of favorite listings.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch their marked favorite listings, enabling them to easily access properties they are interested in. The response will include detailed information about each listing marked as a favorite.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch a list of favorite listings for a user. It expects a JSON structure that adheres to the defined schema for retrieving favorite listings. Ensure that the JSON structure is correctly formed to successfully retrieve the desired data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of favorite listings.
